findings.title: Periodic history refresh aborts slower valid history loads indefinitely
findings.evidence: The history effect aborts the previous historyAbort on each historyTick/tick change. Active runs increment historyTick every2000ms without a history-in-flight guard. A valid list and event-backfill load taking more than2s is aborted before publishing; repeating this leaves cached runs permanently active and prevents fresh status/events. The independent10s context tick can also reset the15s history deadline before it expires.
findings.reproduction_by_source: After one active run is displayed, make runTransport.list+events resolve after3s. The2s interval starts a new effect and aborts the earlier request; its final guard returns before session.runs/setRuns. Repeating responses never advance visible state.
findings.recommended_fix: Single-flight/coalesced history polling or self-schedule after settlement. Periodic context ticks must not cancel an otherwise valid history request. Selection/account changes still abort; coordinate writes so an in-flight mutation cannot be overwritten by an old history snapshot.
findings.fix_verification: pending amended source re-review; no dynamic reproduction run by this reviewer

checked_boundaries.no_fixture_fallback: Fixed relative /research/runs/* POST paths, redirect:error, explicit transport injection only; runtime HTTP discovery requires verified capability. HTTP failures never select fixtures or legacy chat.
checked_boundaries.bindings: Strict five-field binding, readonly frozen context, server-owned flattened submission authority. Snapshot merge preserves full context identity, question, continuation identity, monotonic elapsed/high-water. Event merge checks exact binding and consecutive cursor.
checked_boundaries.acknowledgements: Exact immutable mutation intent and UUID key are remembered before fresh preflight/HTTP; uncertain5xx/abort retains intent; conflicting intents cannot replace it. Successful replay recovers original key/body. Full reload discovers saved runs before submit.
checked_boundaries.account_guards: Runtime generation guards discard stale bootstrap responses; account/permission revision remount/bind clears private maps and intents. Unauthorized failures clear drafts/runs/visible state and abort active requests. Private content uses in-memory maps, not browser persistent storage.
checked_boundaries.events: Fresh status keeps locally verified activity separately from high-water. Initial/history load backfills consecutive pages, controlled20-page chunks with visible remaining-update notice; explicit activity action can fetch more.
checked_boundaries.dispatch_disabled: Verified HTTP history remains connected with submit_enabled false; submit/clarify/continue controls disabled while status/events/cancel remain available.
checked_boundaries.synthesis: HTTP parser rejects nonnull production result and synthetic=true; completed controller exploration displays answer unavailable. Awaiting approval has no invented approval operation.
